response: Saved Views is available today for every workspace on a paid plan. If you've ever rebuilt the same filtered list every Monday morning, this one's for you. Saved Views lets you capture a specific combination of filters, sorting, and grouping, then return to it in a single click instead of reconstructing it from scratch. Each teammate can save up to 50 personal views, covering sprint boards, overdue tasks, client-specific backlogs, or whatever slice of work matters most to them. Views aren't locked to one person, either: share any view with your team so everyone opens the same filtered list, without copying filter settings back and forth or explaining your setup in a meeting. Saved Views is included in all paid plans at no extra cost, so there's nothing new to purchase or activate. It's rolling out now to every account. Open any list and select Save view to get started.
